theme: An open day before a travel day.
greeting: The whole day is open, Dan — nothing on the calendar before tomorrow's drive up I-95. The things worth your time are the two recruiter replies you owe and the holiday travel still to lock in.

needsAttention.title: Reply to the CIFIC recruiter
needsAttention.detail: Amin Noorani at Noorani + Partners wrote Oct 15 about a VP, Government Relations & Regulatory Affairs search and asked if you'd like to explore it. Still unanswered, and he's also keeping you in mind for board seats.

needsAttention.title: Board-search reply waiting
needsAttention.detail: Terence Quek, who leads a CEO & Board of Directors practice, flagged an unanswered LinkedIn message — directly relevant to the board seats you're pursuing.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: The top-priority task to reserve a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is weeks overdue; it's the tightest rental market of the year.

needsAttention.title: December break destination
needsAttention.detail: The Dec 13–Jan 2 trip for all four kids was meant to be decided by Sept 30 and booked by Oct 15 — both windows have passed, and holiday inventory for six keeps thinning.

needsAttention.title: Travel day up I-95
needsAttention.detail: A Fredericksburg, Virginia overnight is booked for tomorrow night, so tomorrow is a day on the road. Tonight is the natural window to pack and settle the route before an early start.

flagged.title: Two recruiter replies owed
flagged.detail: CIFIC's Amin Noorani (Oct 15) and a LinkedIn board-search note from Terence Quek are both awaiting you.

flagged.title: Suspicious document share
flagged.detail: An email from Fran Philip 'shared a document' via doc.ivoryhill.org — not a Google link. Worth a careful look before clicking.

inbox.noise: Mattress Firm, Craighill, Duolingo, Airbnb and a stack of other promos and social pings — nothing that needs you.

resolved.title: Brunswick interviews confirmed
resolved.detail: You and Erika Maass locked in two Brunswick Teams interviews for Oct 27 — Jonathan Doorley at 10am and Christian at 1:30pm.

recipe.title: Apple galette
recipe.why: Autumn's orchard apples are at their peak, and a rustic galette is the simplest way to let them shine.

tasks.title: Portland house order — bedframe + soap holder

acts.line: The calendar is clear — no meetings to shape the morning.
Still open; a long stretch with room for the replies and bookings that have been waiting.
A Fredericksburg, Virginia overnight is booked for tomorrow — the I-95 trip starts in the morning.
